body:
BTC/USD

Bitcoin price trades at $64,830 on Thursday, holding above the 50-day Exponential Moving Average (EMA) at $64,670 but still capped well below the 100-day EMA at $67,049 and the 200-day EMA at $72,564. [...] Bitcoin (BTC) is a decentralized peer-to-peer digital currency originally designed to facilitate digital payments across the globe. Launched by anonymous figure Satoshi Nakamoto in 2009, Bitcoin's success largely depended on how it facilitated recorded ownership and facilitated the transfer of assets through a distributed ledger known as blockchain technology. [...] Bitcoin futures are contracts that enable traders to speculate on the price of Bitcoin without owning the underlying asset. Similar to other futures products, these contracts obligate investors to buy or sell Bitcoin for a predetermined price at a specific date.

Bitcoin is holding roughly flat near $63,000, consolidating in a tight $62,500-$64,500 range as investors weigh a stalled US regulatory agenda against thinning spot demand. The SEC's abrupt cancellation of its Regulation Crypto rulemaking vote and the Senate's failure to advance the CLARITY Act before recess have removed near-term regulatory catalysts, while a Seeking Alpha analysis flagged Bitcoin spot volume at a seven-year low even as futures open interest rises, suggesting leverage rather [...] Bitcoin is trading modestly higher, rebounding toward $78,650 after a volatile weekend session in which renewed U.S.-Iran military strikes and Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's hawkish Jackson Hole remarks pushed the September rate-hike probability to roughly 60%, driving BTC below $77,000 amid nearly $390 million in liquidations. Investors are weighing this macro-driven pullback against still-bullish underlying signals, including Michael Saylor's apparent resumption of Strategy's BTC purchases after a [...] Bitcoin is trading modestly lower, holding just below $64,000 as it consolidates within a multi-week $62,000-$66,000 range ahead of Wednesday's critical July CPI print, which markets see as a key input for September Fed rate decisions. Sentiment remains cautious after Strategy (MSTR) disclosed further BTC sales—1,690 coins sold this week to fund preferred stock buybacks, extending seven consecutive weeks without corporate purchases—while a whale moved 1,275 BTC to exchanges and OTC desks,
